input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Section 17(b) gives us (Sparkling) an unconditional right to terminate at any time on 90 calendar days' written notice, with no early-termination fee or penalty, and Section 11/the Fee Schedule impose no accelerated payment on exit. Garman has no termination-for-convenience right anywhere: Section 17(c) permits termination only for insolvency events or uncured material default, and Section 17(a) makes the licence perpetual while fees are paid. That sits at the playbook fallback (customer notice of 60–90 days, no fee, no vendor convenience right) rather than the preferred 30 days, so it is acceptable and not redlined. Sub-elements short of preferred, noted only: the clause is silent on a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on a convenience termination (a refund of fees for services not rendered applies only on termination for Garman's default under p0128, and full repayment on rejection under Section 8), and maintenance runs in renewable one-year terms, so any prepaid maintenance for the post-termination period would need to be recovered by agreement.
